notes: Tuesday: NBA opening night (3 games) and 11 NHL games.
Game lines on Polymarket US are priced almost the same as the big sportsbooks today, so most of the value is in prop bets.
NHL goalies and lineups confirm later in the day.

singles.reasoning: Slight edge. Polymarket US is a hair cheaper than the big sportsbooks (Vegas -120 at Bovada, -118 at DraftKings). Tobias Harris is out for the Spurs. Close to a coin flip, so the edge is thin.
singles.verdict: Slight edge. Price is a little better than fair.

lineup_note.text: Tobias Harris (calf) is out, which the pick already counted. Spurs start a three-guard lineup: Fox, Castle, Harper, Vassell, Wembanyama. Thunder only miss Topic and Sorber.
lineup_note.source: The Athletic's Jared Weiss via @iBetFantasy; @UnderdogNBA injury list

singles.side: Under 5.5 total goals — NO (5 or fewer)
singles.reasoning: Slight edge. DraftKings has Under 5.5 at +100 and Bovada leans under at its 6 line, and Polymarket US pays a bit more. Goalies (Hofer and Skinner) are not confirmed yet.
singles.verdict: Slight edge. Price is a little better than fair.

lineup_note.text: Goalies set: Stuart Skinner starts for the Jets and Joel Hofer for the Blues, as the pick expected.
lineup_note.source: Ken Wiebe via @GameDayLines; Mitchell Clinton via @GameDayGoalies

singles.side: Under 3.5 total goals — NO (3 or fewer)
singles.reasoning: Long shot. Bovada prices 3 or fewer goals at +425, which works out to a bit more often than the Polymarket US price says. Dostal is confirmed for Anaheim and Sorokin is expected for the Islanders, two good goalies. Most nights this loses.
singles.verdict: Hard to hit, but the price is better than the sportsbook.
singles.pending_news: Ducks goalie (Dostal expected) confirms at warmups.

lineup_note.text: Ilya Sorokin starts for the Islanders. Ducks skipped morning skate and Lukas Dostal is expected in net. Isles are still without Barzal, Maccelli and Ritchie.

props.reasoning: Bovada pays only +130 on this, Polymarket US pays more than double. Carlsson had an assist in 29 of 70 games last season and 4 of 8 this season, and he centers the top line.
props.verdict: Good price compared with what it should be.
props.pending_news: Ducks skipped morning skate; lines confirm at warmups.

lineup_note.text: Carlsson centers the top line with Killorn and Klepov and is on the first power play. Ducks skipped morning skate, so lines carry over from last game.

props.reasoning: A bit cheap compared with Bovada (over 5.5 rebounds at +200). George got 6 or more rebounds in 14 of 37 games last season.
props.verdict: Good price compared with what it should be.

lineup_note.text: Celtics list no injuries and Paul George makes his Celtics debut today.

props.reasoning: A bit cheap compared with Bovada (over 9.5 points at +145). Shamet scored 10 or more in 22 of 51 games last season. Few shares are for sale at this price.
props.verdict: Good price compared with what it should be.
props.pending_news: 76ers injury report (Simons, Wade, Bona questionable) comes out before tip.

lineup_note.text: Knicks list no injuries. For the 76ers, Simons, Wade and Bona are still questionable.

props.reasoning: Bovada pays +102, Polymarket US pays more. McAvoy had an assist in 40 of 69 games last season, but only 1 in 3 games so far this year.
props.verdict: Good price compared with what it should be.

lineup_note.text: McAvoy is on the top pair with Hampus Lindholm at morning skate and Swayman is in net. Oettinger starts for Dallas, and Stars D Esa Lindell is out.
lineup_note.source: Belle Fraser via @GameDayLines; Bruce LeVine via @GameDayGoalies

props.reasoning: A little cheap compared with Bovada (15+ points at +200). Hart scored 15 or more in 22 of 67 games last season.
props.verdict: Price looks a little better than fair.

lineup_note.text: Knicks list no injuries, so Hart plays.

props.reasoning: A little cheap compared with Bovada (over 5.5 assists at +200). White had 6 or more assists in 31 of 77 games last season.
props.verdict: Price looks a little better than fair.

lineup_note.text: Celtics list no injuries, so White plays. Pistons are only missing Taurean Prince.

parlays.event: Wild @ Oilers + Maple Leafs @ Blue Jackets
parlays.side: Adam Fantilli 2+ points + Ryan Shea 1+ points
parlays.reasoning: Two NO picks from different games. Fantilli had 2 or more points in only 13 of 82 games last season and 0 of 7 this year. Shea had a point in 27 of 80 games last season. Both pay a bit more than Bovada says they should. They do not affect each other.
parlays.pending_news: Fantilli is on the top line (Greaves starts for CBJ); Oilers lineup for Shea not confirmed yet.

parlays.side: Evan Rodrigues 1+ points + Spurs +8.5 (Thunder win by 9+
parlays.reasoning: Rodrigues had a point in 25 of 69 games last season, and Bovada prices him to get one less often than the app does. Spurs +8.5 means the Spurs win, or lose by 8 or fewer. Different games, so they do not affect each other.

lineup_note.text: Rodrigues plays but moved back to the second power play (Evangelista returns to PP1), a small plus for the no-point side. Jake Allen starts for NJ. Spurs are without Tobias Harris, already counted.

parlays.side: Blues to win + Oilers to win
parlays.reasoning: Two home favorites priced about the same as the big sportsbooks. No real edge, just a fair price. Daily Faceoff lists Hofer for the Blues and Devon Levi for the Oilers, both not confirmed.
parlays.pending_news: Hofer starts for the Blues; Oilers goalie not confirmed yet.

longshots.side: Leo Carlsson 1+ assists + Paul George 6+ rebounds + Landry Shamet 10+ points
longshots.reasoning: Three prop bets that are each cheaper than at Bovada, from three different games. All 3 hitting is rare, but the payout is bigger than the real chance.
longshots.verdict: Hard to hit. Good payout for the chance.
longshots.pending_news: Ducks skipped morning skate; lines confirm at warmups.

lineup_note.text: All three play: Carlsson on the Ducks' top line and PP1, and the Celtics and Knicks list no injuries.

longshots.side: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 35+ points + Josh Hart 15+ points + Derrick White 6+ assists
longshots.reasoning: SGA scored 35 or more in 20 of 68 games last season, Hart 15 or more in 22 of 67, and White had 6 or more assists in 31 of 77. Each one is a bit cheap compared with Bovada. All 3 hitting is very rare.
longshots.verdict: Hard to hit. Good payout for the chance.

lineup_note.text: All three play. Thunder only miss Topic and Sorber, and the Knicks and Celtics list no injuries.
